name: praxis-node
description: Probabilistic Risk Assessment Toolset — Node.js native addon

scripts.build: cargo build --features napi-rs --release && cp target/release/libpraxis.so praxis.node 2>/dev/null || cp target/release/libpraxis.dylib praxis.node 2>/dev/null || cp target/release/praxis.dll praxis.node 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.build:debug: cargo build --features napi-rs && cp target/debug/libpraxis.so praxis.node 2>/dev/null || cp target/debug/libpraxis.dylib praxis.node 2>/dev/null || true
